notes: Existing page entry: (1) causes 'Tobacco smoking (85 to 90% of cases)' - NHS says around 9 in 10, WHO figure not retrieved; roughly consistent. (2) diagnosis cites 'FEV1/FVC ratio below 0.7': sources retrieved confirm 0.7 (NICE NG115 via local guideline) but a London ICB note says ARTP uses lower limit of normal; also this is a cut-off in prose. (3) treatment 'Stopping smoking is the only measure that slows decline' - NHS says it is the most effective way to prevent worsening; 'only' not supported, and a trust guideline says no medicine shown to modify long-term decline. (4) 'Long-acting bronchodilator inhalers (with inhaled steroids for frequent exacerbators)' - broadly supported. (5) 'Exacerbations are treated with steroids and often antibiotics' - MedlinePlus lists steroids or antibiotics by mouth among options; 'often' not supported. (6) overview 'COPD is the third leading cause of death worldwide' and 'dissolve the alveolar walls' - not retrieved this pass (WHO page not re-read for the figure). (7) 'Barrel chest' / 'cyanosis' signs, 'Osteoporosis, muscle wasting, depression', 'Lung cancer' complications and 'Asthma' as a risk factor - not retrieved. (8) seekCare: 'blue lips' is supported by MedlinePlus as a contact-provider sign; 'new confusion or drowsiness (carbon dioxide retention)' - confusion/sleepiness supported, CO2 gloss not retrieved. (9) 'Pack-years of smoking', 'Childhood respiratory infections' not retrieved. Draft attribution errors fixed: NHS Devon page (c36) was actually the NHS treatment page; alpha-1/air pollution (c17) is from WHO; 999 advice (c46) is from South Tees trust page. Final text drops numbers such as 'six weeks' and 'age 35 (NICE)'; 'over 35' and 'two days or more' and '9 in 10' kept because retrieved and attributed.
